thread:
jordan: Quick sync — ACME just pushed: SSO + audit logs must be in our v1 for their enterprise sign-off. They want it in next week's cut. Need a decision by EOD.

maria: Confirming — ACME legal says PoC sign-off linked to SSO in product. They're flexible on audit details but SSO is a hard ask. They said they'd pause pilot otherwise.

sanjay: SSO + enterprise-grade audit is a non-trivial scope add. Full SAML + provisioning + audit retention is at least 3 sprint-weeks. Not sure we can do that safely before next week. :grimacing:

ashley: We need to map this to release gating. Current v1 bar is: stable core generation, basic routing, and perf SLOs. Anything enterprise is optional post-launch, unless we treat it as a gated enterprise add.

jordan: Proposal A: keep core v1 as-is, push full SSO + audit to v1.1. Proposal B: scope a minimal SSO MVP (OIDC + single-tenant login + flag) for early customers and treat audit logs as a follow-up. Looking for tradeoffs.

oliver: Design note — OIDC-only flow is much faster to UX-complete. SAML screens + IdP mapping takes more time and edge-cases. If we do MVP-SOO (OIDC) we can reuse the current OAuth surface.

sanjay: If we go OIDC-only with feature flag, engineering effort drops to ~4-6 dev-days + 2 for infra and testing. Still need security review.

maria: ACME will accept an OIDC-flagged beta if we provide a written roadmap with committed dates for SAML and audit. They want an SLA blurb for the pilot.

ashley: We should require these launch gating artifacts before any scope shift: short security checklist, perf smoke, and a documented rollback plan. If those pass, we can enable enterprise flags for a small set of customers.

jordan: Drafting a "scope-flex lanes" approach: core v1 ships public; enterprise features (SSO/SAML/audit) are gated behind an "enterprise-bundle" flag. For customers in pilot we enable flag manually after gating is green. This preserves timeline and keeps ACME onboard.

sanjay: Agreed, feature-flagged enterprise bundle makes sense. Need clear default: off for GA, on-per-customer for pilot. Also recommend telemetry hooks and a kill-switch.

oliver: I'll sketch the minimal screens and error states for OIDC + onboarding. Should be able to deliver mocks by tomorrow morning.

maria: I'll get ACME's legal to sign a pilot addendum that references the roadmap commitment and pilot SLA. That buys us runway.

jordan: Action items (quick):
```
- [ ] sanjay: estimate + infra checklist by 3pm today
- [ ] oliver: OIDC mockups by 10am tomorrow
- [ ] ashley: short security checklist + rollback plan by EOD
- [ ] maria: pilot addendum draft by EOD
- [ ] jordan: spin up exec note and get approval for feature-flagged pilot
```

ashley: Also adding risk matrix:
- Risk: SAML edge cases -> mitigated by deferring to v1.1
- Risk: Perf/regression -> blocked until perf smoke test passes
- Risk: Customer trust -> mitigated by pilot SLA and roadmap commit

maria: ACME reaction: :thumbsup: to the feature-flagged pilot approach. They asked we prioritize SAML in roadmap but will accept the OIDC path to unblock sign-off.

jordan: Okay — we make a call: OIDC MVP behind enterprise flag, ship core v1 public, commit to SAML + audit in v1.1 with dates. If anyone strongly disagrees, tell me now; otherwise we'll move forward and I'll post to exec sync.

sanjay: No objections from eng. Will post estimates in thread by 1500.

oliver: No objections from design.

ashley: No objections from program. I'll attach the security checklist to this thread when done.

maria: I'll update ACME and attach legal draft.

devrel-bot: Note created: "ACME SSO scope decision" assigned to jordan, due 1789128000. :white_check_mark:

jordan: Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate and push to exec. :rocket:
